Written by tools/legacy-script-audit.py --recheck, completed by hand during the conversion; read by tests/scripts/run-all.mjs and tools/release-notes-scripts.py. Status 'recheck' marks a converted package whose 2.7.9 successor differs and is not rechecked yet (US4 turns it into updated, unchanged or kept).

entries.source: 02_Примечания/12_Создать сноски или комментарии из выделенных абзацев....js

names.ru: Создать сноски или комментарии из выделенных абзацев
names.en: Sozdat snoski ili comments from vydelennykh of paragraphs

htmlDialogs: HTML/Создать сноски из выделенных абзацев - задание параметров.htm
differences: The modeless dialog is a form whose action choice holds the dialog's buttons (Создать сноски, Создать комментарии - with or without «и выйти» -, Предпросмотр); the form comes back where the dialog stayed open (after a preview, a count that does not agree, a declined confirmation or an error), and creating the notes ends the run, where the buttons without «и выйти» kept the dialog open for another run.
The preview is a report window with the note texts numbered 1, 2... under the original's heading and «Количество: N» (2.7.9 opened an HTML window styled like the book).
«задать свой» is chosen in its own right (the dialog chose it when the text field got the focus).
Without a selection the message ends the run (the menu item needs a selection anyway): a modal form cannot wait while the user selects text, the modeless dialog could.

A custom marker that is not a valid regular expression gets the message of 15-24 («Произошла ошибка при компиляции регэкспа для маркера знака сноски.») and the form comes back; 2.7.9 stopped with a script error.
A poem's date is not searched for signs: FB2 allows no link in it (FictionBook Editor showed the date as a P of class text-author and searched it).

An epigraph taken into a note text where it cannot open the section becomes a cite, and a new section with no note link before it goes before the first section of the notes body, after the body's title and epigraphs (2.7.9 put it right after the title, before the epigraphs): FB2 allows an epigraph only at the start of a section and before the first section of a body.
The selection is put back where it was after the notes are made (2.7.9 selected from its block markers with a setEndPoint call whose result depended on Internet Explorer).

A new note link inside formatting is written with the formatting inside the link ([4] for 2.7.9's ...[4]): the editor nests a link outside the formatting of the same characters; the text and its formatting are the same.
A pattern typed into the dialog is a JavaScript regular expression: JScript's \s did not match U+00A0 or the other Unicode spaces, JavaScript's does.
fixes: The walk over the selection goes on after a poem, cite, table or epigraph that ends its section (2.7.9 stopped there and lost the rest of the selection), stops after the container that holds the end of the selection (2.7.9 did not see its end marker inside it and took every paragraph after the selection up to the end of the book or the next such container ending a section), and no longer fails on a selection that starts inside such a container ending its section (a script error in 2.7.9).

A note link before a sign that points to no section of the notes body (an id that does not exist, or one outside the notes body) stops the creation with the original's message «Ошибка!» before anything changes, and the form comes back; 2.7.9 showed the message and went on, leaving that sign replaced by a link with the placeholder text «Œ±Ǥ» and its note text unused (with a link pointing outside the notes body it put the new section next to whatever the link pointed to).

A sign of Unicode superscript digits and <sup> digits together (¹<sup>2</sup>) loses its own characters only; 2.7.9 measured the match with its <SUP> tags and removed as many characters again after it.
A pattern that matches empty text finds no sign there (2.7.9 looped for ever on such a match).

differences: The modeless dialog is a form whose action choice holds the dialog's buttons (Создать сноски, Создать комментарии - with or without «и выйти» -, Предпросмотр); the form comes back where the dialog stayed open (after a preview, a count that does not agree, a declined confirmation or an error), and creating the notes ends the run, where the buttons without «и выйти» kept the dialog open for another run.
The preview is a report window with the note texts numbered 1, 2... under the original's heading and «Количество: N» (2.7.9 opened an HTML window styled like the book).
A poem's date is not searched for signs: FB2 allows no link in it (FictionBook Editor showed the date as a P of class text-author and searched it).

An epigraph taken into a note text where it cannot open the section becomes a cite, and a new section with no note link before it goes before the first section of the notes body, after the body's title and epigraphs (2.7.9 put it right after the title, before the epigraphs): FB2 allows an epigraph only at the start of a section and before the first section of a body.
A section whose content was all source paragraphs keeps an empty line: FB2 wants content in a section, and 2.7.9 left the section with its title only.

A new note link inside formatting is written with the formatting inside the link ([4] for 2.7.9's ...[4]): the editor nests a link outside the formatting of the same characters; the text and its formatting are the same.
fixes: The notes and comments bodies are not searched for note texts: 2.7.9's walk meant to skip them but tested the wrong node (the first child of the element instead of the element), so a paragraph of an existing note that started with the marker became a note text and was removed with the sources.
The sections made in the run are not searched for signs: 2.7.9's walk went on into them, so a note text holding the sign character got a section of its own whose text was «undefined».

A note link before a sign that points to no section of the notes body (an id that does not exist, or one outside the notes body) stops the creation with the original's message «Ошибка! Ссылка в документе указывает на элемент, которого не существует.» before anything changes, and the form comes back; 2.7.9 showed the message and went on, leaving that sign replaced by a link with the placeholder text «Œ±Ǥ» and its note text unused (with a link pointing outside the notes body it put the new section next to whatever the link pointed to).

Text before a sign that holds «&» no longer shifts the sign: the dialog's unmakeEntities left «&» five characters long (a misplaced parenthesis), so after an ampersand 2.7.9 put the link four characters past the sign, left the sign and deleted a character there.
openQuestions: A paragraph starting with the continuation marker («++») continues the note text before it wherever it stands, also after paragraphs that are no note text (the dialog's previosPWasPartOfNote is never set false); kept as in 2.7.9.

differences: A picture is one character of the paragraph's text (2.7.9 wrote it as three placeholder characters, shifting a selection after it by two per picture).

The original's addMacros definitions, which only tagRegExp expressions use and this script has none of, are not carried over.
The view is not scrolled by the original's scrollIfItNeeds; selecting the match brings it into view.
fixes: The message about a selected picture printed the words «sel.type»; it reads «Не обрабатываемый тип выделения: выделена картинка.» now (the fix of group 16's engine).

differences: The links are turned into notes directly on the document: the temporary brackets 【♣★ ★♣】 are never written into the text (a book that already holds them is still refused with the original's message and the pattern on the clipboard).

A note link inside formatting is written with the formatting inside the link ([3] for 2.7.9's ...[3]): the editor nests a link outside the formatting of the same characters; the text and its formatting are the same.
fixes: A comment link after an external link that points to no section of the comments body stops the run before anything changes, with the original's message, the caret on that link and «Добавлено комментариев: 0»; 2.7.9 stopped in the middle: the external links before it were notes already, this one and every later one stayed in the text as «【♣★address★♣】».

entries.predecessor: 04_Примечания и комментарии из скобок/612_Комментарии из скобок, заданных простым текстом.js
differences: Inline formatting that crosses a bracket is kept by the document model's marks, so the original's error «Не все тэги, открытые внутри скобок, в них закрываются» cannot occur.
The banner lines of the message are not centred with leading spaces (since 0.0.1).
fixes: The cover of the src-title-info counts as used, and a binary counts as a cover only when its id is the cover's address: the original read the title-info cover list alone, as one text in which it looked for the id, so it reported the binary of the src-title-info cover as unused and took a binary whose id is part of the cover's address for the cover (kept from the 0.0.1 conversion).

A picture whose address points outside the book is listed under that address; the original listed what follows the 14th character of the picture's internal address, "ttp://example.com/x.png" for http://example.com/x.png (the 0.0.1 conversion did not list such pictures).

differences: The script interface can neither rename nor reorder binary objects (since 0.0.1): the plan is worked out as the original works it out and reported in the message as the planned renames not applied; applied is only what needs no renaming - the #nobin_ addresses of the pictures without a binary and a cover taken from a binary named cover.png, cover.jpg or cover.jpeg (cover_src.*) under its present name. 2.7.9 renames the binaries, points the pictures and the covers to the new names and puts the binaries in the order covers, illustrations, displaced covers, unused, neither JPEG nor PNG. Once the interface can rename a binary, the renames are applied through temporary names, as the original does.

A book without a src-title-info gets no cover of the original edition from a binary named cover_src.*: FictionBook Editor's description form always holds that cover list, so 2.7.9 wrote a src-title-info with empty required fields.

entries.reason: It acts on the editor's own page only: it reassigns the src of every IMG of the Internet Explorer view so that the pictures are drawn again, and refills the cover lists of the description form (FillCoverList). The book is not changed, and the editor's views show a binary object's current content by themselves, so there is nothing to refresh.
entries.needs: Access to the editor's own page (its rendered pictures and its description form), which spec FR-024 keeps out of scripts' reach; no API change is proposed, as the editor redraws the pictures itself.

differences: The editor's folder dialog chooses where the files go (mfbe.files.saveBinaries; the original wrote them next to the book, in its folder): the confirmation says the files go into a folder the user chooses, and cancelling the dialog ends the run without a message.
A file that exists already is the editor's question - Overwrite, Skip, Overwrite all or Cancel; the original never overwrote one (CREATE_NEW) and counted it as not saved.
entries.reason: dropped in the conversion of 2.7beta1; to be re-examined under FR-024 with script API version 2 (T069)

differences: The script interface has no call to remove a binary object (since 0.0.1): after the confirmation the script says how many binary objects the document has and that the Binary Objects panel removes them; it removes them itself once the interface has such a call.

The undo step carries the package's label, the script's name; the original's "удаление всех вложений" (2.7beta1: "binaries deleting") is passed as the step's name (mfbe.edit.label), which the editor does not show.

names.ru: Добавить либо удалить пустые строки возле иллюстраций
names.en: Add libo udalit empty lines vozle illyustratsiy

differences: The undo step carries the package's label, the script's name; the original's, which names the mode ("добавление пустых строк возле иллюстраций" or "удаление пустых строк возле иллюстраций"; 2.7beta1: "empty lines near images"), is passed as the step's name (mfbe.edit.label), which the editor does not show.
fixes: A paragraph holding an inline picture is not an empty line: the original tested the paragraph's text (innerText), which has nothing for a picture, so next to a block picture it removed such a paragraph, picture and all, in the removal mode and took it for the empty line, adding none, in the adding mode (kept from the 0.0.1 conversion; snapshots 05/empty-lines-near-images.inline.add.xml and .inline.remove.xml).

differences: The script interface has no call to remove a binary object (since 0.0.1): the script lists the unused binary objects and says that the Binary Objects panel removes them; it removes them itself once the interface has such a call.
One question about addresses outside the book covers the pictures and the covers; the original asked again when a cover had such an address (since 0.0.1).
fixes: A binary used by a further picture of a cover list counts as used: the original read only the first picture of each cover list, so it removed the binary of a second cover picture (kept from the 0.0.1 conversion).

differences: The modeless dialog is a form followed by a question per doubtful paragraph (since 0.0.1): the settings hold for the whole run, the caret cannot be moved between the questions to search on from elsewhere, and the settings are not remembered between runs (the original kept them in cookies).

The dialog's keys K, L and A have no counterpart: Enter marks the paragraph up as a caption, Esc closes. The button "Мигать абзацем", which flashed the paragraph while the mouse was over it, is dropped, since the paragraph is selected; the text of the help popup [?] is a note of the form.

After "Во всех дальнейших случаях разметить как подписи" the final counts cover the whole run; the original began its walk again where its last search had started (the beginning, the caret, or the paragraph last marked or skipped by hand) and counted from there (since 0.0.1).
The length limit counts the characters of the paragraph, a picture as one; the original counted its HTML, where a non-breaking space or one of & < > took four to six characters (since 0.0.1).
With no text block at the caret (a picture selected), "Стартовать от курсора" starts at the beginning of the book; the original started after the selected picture (since 0.0.1).
fixes: A paragraph ending with a full stop, an ellipsis, an exclamation or a question mark followed by spaces is asked about: the original looked at the last character of the paragraph's HTML, so a trailing space or non-breaking space made such a paragraph a caption without asking (kept from the 0.0.1 conversion; snapshot 05/image-captions.inline-pictures.xml).

names.ru: Удалить все теги иллюстраций - теги image
names.en: Udalit all tegi illyustratsiy - tegi image

differences: An empty line whose removal would leave a section with nothing but its title stays and is not counted (FB2 needs content after a title); 2.7.9 removed it and the section became invalid.
A formatting element or a link that held a removed inline picture goes with it; 2.7.9 left it empty (<strong/>, <a/>), which the document model has no form for.

A paragraph emptied of its pictures is written as FictionBook Editor saved it (FBDoc.cpp, ProcessP): an empty line, in a stanza a verse of one space, a table cell an empty cell; where FB2 allows no empty line (a poem's text author) it stays an empty paragraph (2.7.9 saved an empty line there, leaving the book invalid).
The count of 'unclear (probably wrong)' pictures - an IMG outside an image element, which 2.7.9 showed only when not 0 - is gone: the editor's document has no such picture.
fixes: The word 'undefined' no longer counts as an empty line: the original built its empty-line expression before setting its non-breaking space variable, so the expression read '( | | |undefined)*' and a paragraph 'undefined' next to a removed picture was removed with it. Now only spaces and non-breaking spaces make an empty line.

The empty line after a picture that opens its section goes when more text follows: the original's operator precedence (!prev || prevIsTitle && nextIsEmpty && nextIsLast) kept it whatever followed; it was meant to stay only when it is the last thing after the picture, as after a title or an epigraph (needed for validity).

differences: A block picture has no caret position of its own in the Body view: the caret goes to the end of the text right before the picture, or - when another picture or nothing lies there - right at the picture's side (a place between blocks), so that the next run goes on from there; 2.7.9 put the caret wherever the arrow key moved Internet Explorer's caret off the picture.
The check 'Установите курсор в документ!' (the caret outside the book) is dropped: scripts see the Body view's selection only.
The editor scrolls the place into view; the original's GoTo centred the picture in the window.
fixes: A selected picture no longer stops the script with an error: the original's 'костыль от ошибки выделения' (stokber, 2025) stepped off the selected picture with Shift+Esc and an arrow key, but its code went on with the range it had failed to copy (a picture's selection is a control range) and stopped with a script error; the search now starts beside the picture, where that step put the caret - after it going forwards, before it going backwards.

differences: A block picture has no caret position of its own in the Body view: the caret goes to the start of the text right after the picture, or - when another picture or nothing lies there - right at the picture's side (a place between blocks), so that the next run goes on from there; 2.7.9 put the caret wherever the arrow key moved Internet Explorer's caret off the picture.
The check 'Установите курсор в документ!' (the caret outside the book) is dropped: scripts see the Body view's selection only.
The editor scrolls the place into view; the original's GoTo centred the picture in the window.
fixes: A selected picture no longer stops the script with an error: the original's 'костыль от ошибки выделения' (stokber, 2025) stepped off the selected picture with Shift+Esc and an arrow key, but its code went on with the range it had failed to copy (a picture's selection is a control range) and stopped with a script error; the search now starts beside the picture, where that step put the caret - after it going forwards, before it going backwards.

differences: The result message shows no proverb: left out pending the requester's decision (the original appended a random saying from its list of wartime proverbs; the list is not copied into the package).

An edit FB2 does not allow there is neither made nor counted: removing an empty line that would leave a section with its title alone, dissolving a container whose content may not stand in its place (an empty line in a body or a poem); 2.7.9 made them and the book became invalid.
A cite or poem around a picture line is dissolved in one step (with its stanza), and the verse becomes a paragraph, as 2.7.9 saved it.

During a question the place is shown by the selection (scrolled into view) instead of a lilac or red highlight of the line; the original's 'B mode' (Body view) check and its refreshing of the pictures have no counterpart, scripts edit the book itself.

By the requester's decision (2026-10-31) the history line carries no user name: the setting youName is empty, the original's own way to a line without a name, so the line reads "v.<new version> —  Скрипт: «Пустые строки рядом с иллюстрациями» 2.1 — (<date>)" and a line of the last ten days is extended when it ends "— (<date>)"; 2.7.9's default was the placeholder 'Зорро' ("— (Зорро, <date>)"), and the original also took a fbeUserName variable of its main.js when there was one, which the editor has not. A script that runs this one may pass the settings in ctx.args (youName among them), and 'today' (YYYY-MM-DD), the date of the history line (the tests do).
openQuestions: Restore the proverb of the result message?

entries.source: 05_Иллюстрации/14_Удалить все иллюстрации, их тэги и пустые строки (комбо).js

names.ru: Удалить все иллюстрации, их тэги и пустые строки (комбо)
names.en: Udalit all illyustratsii, their tegi and empty lines (kombo)

differences: The whole run is one undo step under this script's name, and one Cancel stops it and leaves the book as it was; in 2.7.9 each script of the list made an undo step of its own (script API v2: a chain of scripts is one run).

05/remove-unused-binaries is run by its id: its manifest still names its 2.7beta1 file (05_Иллюстрации/07_Удаление неиспользуемых вложений....js; the package is unchanged in 2.7.9), so the 2.7.9 path the original names does not resolve. The other six run by the 2.7.9 paths the original names.

The binary objects stay in the book: the script API cannot remove one, so 05/remove-all-binaries and 05/remove-unused-binaries say so and leave them, where 2.7.9 removed them all. 05/unify-binaries therefore still finds them and applies only the nobin_ prefix of a picture without a binary (its renames need an API to rename binaries), and 05/remove-unused-binaries lists the unused one. The text comes out as the seven scripts leave it when run one after another: pictures, their tags and the empty lines next to them, styles and ids go, titles lose bold and italics, "* * *" becomes a subtitle.

Everything else is the behaviour of the scripts it runs, each with its own recorded differences: 05/empty-lines-near-images, 05/remove-all-binaries, 05/unify-binaries, 05/remove-unused-binaries, 05/remove-image-tags, 06/remove-styles-and-ids, 13/subtitles-empty-lines-plain-titles.

The details - on a count mismatch, and the pictures left out as probable covers or copies - open in a report window (mfbe.ui.report); 2.7.9 showed them in a message box (its own MyMsgWindow, which opened HTML/Расставить иллюстрации по заданным местам.html, a page 2.7.9 does not ship, is commented out).

The original's refresh of the view's pictures and cover lists, and its replacement of the   entity by a visible non-breaking space character in the first body, have no counterpart: the editor shows the binaries as they are and keeps non-breaking spaces as such. Its clean-up of the first body's paragraphs of white space (empty lines) is kept.

2.7.9 ships this script twice, byte for byte the same, as '15_Расставить иллюстрации по заданным местам 1.3.js' (with an icon) and '15_Расставить иллюстрации по заданным местам.js'; both are kept, in 2.7.9's menu order (folders 15_place-images-1-3 and 15_place-images-at-placeholders), with one engine.
fixes: The covers of the src-title-info count as covers too, and a binary is a cover when its '#id' is a cover's address: the original read the title-info's cover list only, as a text the id had to occur in, so the src-title-info cover (or a binary whose id is part of a cover's address) could be put into the text.

The cover-like names left out are 'cover.*' and 'cover_src.*' (with '_N' after them): the original's expressions read 'cover(_crs)?', a slip for the 'cover_src' that 'Унифицировать иллюстрации и вложения' and 'Обновить иллюстрации (версия Александра Ка)' give the src-title-info cover.

A place is found by its address, letter case aside as in the original, also when the picture has an id or a title: the original's regular expression over the body's HTML required the attribute layout of a picture without them, so such a place was skipped and its binary went to the next place of the same name.
The message counts the pictures placed: the original reported the smaller of the two counts, whatever was placed.
openQuestions: The opening message promises the alphabetical order of the illustrations' names, but the code places them in the order of the binary objects (kept): sort them by name?

Only the places of the first body are filled, as the original's comment says ('только первое body'), but those of the book annotation, the history and the other bodies are counted, so the counts can match while some binaries stay unplaced (kept): count the first body's places only?
The probable covers and copies are listed with an unanchored expression and left out with an anchored one, so an unused 'mycover.jpg' is listed as skipped ('cover.jpg') but placed (kept)?

The pictures kept are no longer counted as removed: the original's last loop tested the IMG elements left, which have no address, against that expression, took them out of the view (the saved book kept them) and counted each as an 'unclear (probably wrong)' picture, so in a book with pictures its message never said that none was found.

differences: The copies keep their ids: the script interface cannot rename a binary object (the original renamed each copy whose pictures it moved to '<original>_COPY_01.<ext>', '_COPY_02' and so on, for the user to spot them before removing them). The pictures are moved to the original as in 2.7.9.

fixes:
The original's test of a section (sectionNeedsRemoving) stopped at the section's first subsection: after removing an empty subsection it took that subsection for content (its "neither a

nor a title" check), returned "keep" and never looked at the later subsections; and any other content (an epigraph, a subsection with text) ended the test before the later subsections too. The script's intent, stated by its name, is to remove every section holding only a title and empty lines; here every subsection is examined, the empty ones are removed, and a section left with nothing but its title and empty lines is removed with them. On the reference book 2.7.9 removes 7 sections (b, c, e, g1, h1, k, n9) and leaves the empty chapters g3, h2 (with its part h, then holding only a title and h2) and i1; the conversion removes 11 (h with h1 and h2, and g3 and i1 besides).

The script only opens its dialog (HTML/Управление структурой разделов и их заголовками - набор фреймов.html, v2.0 by Sclex), a drag-and-drop editor of the book's tree of bodies and sections with the text runs between them as leaves: several items are dragged at once to any place and level, deleted (Del), renamed in place with the title's formatting (F2, an editable copy of the title), wrapped in a new section, expanded and collapsed, walked with the keyboard; Save writes the whole page back. The forms of the script API (text, number, checkbox, select, radio, list, static and, in version 2, regexp fields) cannot express a live, editable, reorderable tree, and none of version 2's powers (clipboard, files, report window, running other scripts) bears on it; a series of forms would be another program, not this dialog. The editor's Document Tree moves sections (Move Left, Move Right, Move With Children) and deletes them, and titles are edited in the Body view.
entries.needs: A form field kind for an editable tree: the items with their nesting, moved by drag-and-drop or by commands (several at once), deleted, renamed in place keeping their inline formatting, wrapped in a new container, the result returned as the new structure; or an API that opens the Document Tree for a script and returns the user's changes as one run.

entries.source: 08_Структура разделов/03_Раздел под курсором - обрамить другим (новым) разделом.js

names.ru: Раздел под курсором - обрамить другим (новым) разделом
names.en: Section pod kursorom - obramit drugim (novym) razdelom

differences: A section with nothing after its title, epigraphs, picture and annotation is reported («В разделе нет содержимого, которое можно обрамить другим разделом.») and left alone; the original wrapped nothing into an empty new section, which FB2 does not allow (2.7.9 asked before saving such a book). Since 0.0.1, kept.

entries.source: 08_Структура разделов/06_Cбросить структуру до разделов первого уровня.js

names.ru: Cбросить структуру до разделов первого уровня
names.en: Cbrosit strukturu do of sections of the first urovnya

differences: A section left with its title, epigraphs, picture or annotation only (one whose text was all in its subsections) gets an <empty-line/>, so that it stays valid FB2; 2.7.9 wrote it with its heading only, which FB2 does not allow (2.7.9 asked before saving such a book).
fixes: The body's own picture, title and epigraphs stay in the body. On the original's page they were children of the body's DIV like its sections, so the walk wrapped them in a first section of their own: the book's title became the title of a chapter and, the picture coming before the title, the section was invalid. 2.7.9's result starts with that extra section; here the body keeps its heading.

Every new section keeps the id of the section it comes from (the section that held its title and text). 2.7.9 wrote each section as a bare <DIV class=section>, without its id, so the links to sections broke.

differences: Should the merged section start with two pictures (a section's own picture followed by the picture of a subsection), an <empty-line/> goes between them: FB2 does not allow a picture as the first block after a section's picture.
The status text «Полный сброс структуры разделов успешно завершен.» stays after the run (the script API clears a status at the end of the run unless it is sticky).
fixes: The text author of a body epigraph stays a text author. The original took the class off every text-author whose parent was an epigraph - right for the section epigraphs it dissolved, but also in the body epigraphs it kept as epigraphs, whose authors became plain paragraphs.

The titles and epigraphs of poems and the titles of stanzas are kept. The original dissolved every title and epigraph that was not directly in a body, so a poem's title and epigraph became paragraphs inside the poem (invalid FB2, which 2.7.9 asked before saving) and a stanza's title became a verse.

The attributes the original's rebuild dropped are kept: a body's name, the style of paragraphs and tables, the alignment of rows and cells and the spans of cells (it wrote every element again from its class and id only). A poem's date also stays a date (2.7.9's page showed dates as text authors and saved them so).

differences: The repairs of the page's HTML find nothing: 100 and 103 (text or inline tags outside a paragraph, a paragraph without its end tag), 150 (a title in the middle of a section), 201/202 (a formatting tag inside the same tag, with its question and the offer of a cite) and 211 (the code   where the editor shows another character). The editor's model holds inline content only inside text blocks, a title only at the start of its section, formatting as marks (nested formatting of one kind is merged when a book is read) and the non-breaking space as a character.

A section left with its title and a picture only (the picture taken out of the only paragraph of a titled section) gets an <empty-line/> after the picture, so that it stays valid FB2; 2.7.9 left the section without text.

With the settings that ask about single places (311 in ask mode; 503, the title made from a body's name, when merging bodies) the place is not shown while the question is open: the book is written when the script ends. The 311 question quotes the title line instead.
The automatic version raise and history entry of the original's settings (Version_on_off, off in 2.7.9) is not offered.
The result message shows no proverb: left out pending the requester's decision.

A note or comment link that sat inside formatting simply loses that formatting: the editor keeps formatting as marks, so where the link sat in the formatting is not known, and the original's follow-up of moving the spaces at the edges of the split formatting out of it (re323) is not made.
The superscript of a comment link is written in the editor's order of marks, not necessarily inside the link as the original wrote it.
fixes: A picture that is a link (a note marker or a hyperlink) is not taken out of its paragraph (231, 232 and 301 leave it). The settings at the top of the original say that such pictures are not processed, but its expression removed every tag around the picture, the link included, so the picture lost its link and became a block picture.

A picture inside a note or comment link is kept. The original meant to remove the code and style formatting inside such links but tested mSUP.className instead of mSPAN[jj].className, so it removed the picture's own element too and the picture was lost on saving.
openQuestions: Restore the proverb of the result message?

entries.source: 09_Стихи/01_Объединить выделенные подряд идущие стихи в один стих.js

names.ru: Объединить выделенные подряд идущие стихи в один стих
names.en: Obedinit vydelennye podryad idushchie poems into one poem

differences: After a merge the original's clearEmpties removed every empty line from the first one after the previous poem up to the end of their container (its loop runs on to the last sibling), not only the empty lines between the two poems; the conversion removes only those between them (since 0.0.1; 2.7.9 kept the code).

Whether a poem's first stanza lies in the selection: the original marked the ends of the selection with elements and walked between them; the conversion takes a stanza whose first line is one of the selected blocks, unless the selection starts inside that line (since 0.0.1).

A selection in a text field of FictionBook Editor's description page got the message «Ошибка. Должно быть выделение в тексте книги, а не в поле ввода.»; the script works on the Body view's selection, the only one the script API gives (since 0.0.1).

A non-breaking space counts as a space, as the original's comparisons with nbspChar mean: the original read the paragraph's innerHTML, where the character is the entity  , six ordinary characters for its loop, so a name spaced out with non-breaking spaces was too long to be marked and that spacing was never removed (since 0.0.1).
The result message also gives the number of paragraphs marked («Размечено абзацев: N.»; the original declared a counter but never used it) and leaves out the line of dots (since 0.0.1).

The answer to «Сколько символов может быть до точки или скобки?» is read as a number; the original evaluated it as a JScript expression (eval), so 5+5 also gave 10. An answer that is not a number ends the script, as an expression that failed did (since 0.0.1).

The selected blocks are merged by kind: consecutive paragraphs, or verse lines of one stanza, become the first of them, which keeps its attributes. The original rewrote the paragraph boundaries in the selection's HTML,

with nothing but an align attribute on the second paragraph; so it also merged a following empty line into a paragraph (keeping its non-breaking space) and a paragraph into a preceding subtitle or text author, and left alone a boundary before a paragraph that has an id or a style (since 0.0.1).

Run without a selection (the menu entry needs one), the conversion says so in a message, and after a merge the status bar gives the number of paragraphs merged; the original did and showed nothing (since 0.0.1).

entries.source: 09_Стихи/10_Создать (под)заголовки из первых строк стихов, ориентируясь по абзацам-звездочкам....js

names.ru: Создать (под)заголовки из первых строк стихов, ориентируясь по абзацам-звездочкам
names.en: Sozdat (pod)zagolovki from pervykh strok stikhov, orientiruyas po abzatsam-zvezdochkam

differences: The paragraphs and containers the script's expressions leave as they were are written back as they were read, with what 2.7.9's page did not show (a poem's date, xml:lang, a paragraph's style, the spans of table cells, a picture's alt text); 2.7.9 saved its rebuilt page, where dates had become text authors and those attributes were gone.
fixes: A non-breaking space between the asterisks of a line counts as a space. The expression of an asterisk line was built before nbspEntity was set (the try block that sets it comes further down), so it held the word «undefined» instead of « », and lines such as «* * *» were not taken for asterisk lines; now they are.

Asterisk lines in a section annotation lose their protection marks at the end. The original protected the asterisk lines of cites, poems, stanzas, epigraphs and annotations with ☺…☻ but removed the marks in cites, poems, stanzas and epigraphs only, so «☺* * *☻» stayed in the text of annotations (and the result message counted those lines as marked up).

names.ru: Разметка стихов между разделами с заголовками
names.en: Razmetka stikhov mezhdu razdelami s zagolovkami

differences: The paragraphs and containers the script's expressions leave as they were are written back as they were read, with what 2.7.9's page did not show (a poem's date, xml:lang, a paragraph's style, the spans of table cells, a picture's alt text); 2.7.9 saved its rebuilt page, where dates had become text authors and those attributes were gone.
openQuestions: if(questAst = true) assigns instead of comparing, so the steps after the poems are made - turning protected asterisk lines back and framing the plain asterisk lines inside the new poems with empty lines, which makes them stanzas of their own - run even when the user answers No to the question about asterisk subtitles. Kept as in 2.7.9: whether the framing was meant to depend on that answer is not clear.

differences: The candidates passed over are not selected on the way (the original selected and scrolled to each in turn); the selection is made where the search stops.

Table cells are not looked at: the original found a short cell, took its row for the fragment and always passed over it (the fragment holds no plain paragraph), so the result is the same; only the caret left by a fruitless search can differ.
fixes: The document history is not searched. The conditions of Sclex's engine can name the annotation but not the history, so a search started at the top of the document went through the history's lines and could stop there, selecting three short history lines as an unmarked poem.

A fragment that ends its section is selected to its end. The original subtracted one character for the line break after the fragment's last line (characterCount--), which a fragment ending its section does not have, so such a poem was selected one character short (and a search after it started one character early).

entries.source: 09_Стихи/38_По очереди расформатировать все стихи от жирности и курсива.js

names.ru: По очереди расформатировать все стихи от жирности и курсива
names.en: Po ocheredi rasformatirovat all poems by zhirnosti and kursiva

differences: The whole run is one undo step under this script's name, and one Cancel stops it and leaves the book as it was; in 2.7.9 each script of the list made an undo step of its own (script API v2: a chain of scripts is one run).
Everything else is the behaviour of the scripts it runs, each with its own recorded differences: 16/next-poem, 19/paragraphs-remove-bold, 19/paragraphs-remove-italics.
openQuestions: As in 2.7.9, the step runs its scripts whatever 16/next-poem returns: when nothing follows the selection, 16/next-poem says so and returns "NotFound", and the paragraph(s) of the selection - the caret's - still lose their bold and italics (snapshot chains/09-next-poem-remove-bold-italics.none). Stop the step after "NotFound"?

entries.source: 09_Стихи/39_Расформатировать все стихи от жирности и курсива.js

names.ru: Расформатировать все стихи от жирности и курсива
names.en: Rasformatirovat all poems by zhirnosti and kursiva

differences: The whole run is one undo step under this script's name, and one Cancel stops it and leaves the book as it was; in 2.7.9 each script of the list made an undo step of its own (script API v2: a chain of scripts is one run).
The run reports the number of poems done as its progress; 2.7.9 showed none.
Everything else is the behaviour of the scripts it runs, each with its own recorded differences: 34/caret-to-document-start, 16/next-poem, 19/paragraphs-remove-bold, 19/paragraphs-remove-italics.
A subtitle of a dissolved stanza that ends up in an epigraph (a poem inside an epigraph) becomes a paragraph: FB2 allows no subtitle there, and 2.7.9 left it, writing an invalid book.

By the requester's decision (2026-10-31) the history line carries no user name: youName is empty, the original's own way to a line without a name, so the line reads "v.<new version> —  Скрипт: «Расформатирование всех стихов» 1.5 — (<date>)" and a line of the last ten days is extended when it ends "— (<date>)"; 2.7.9's default was the placeholder "Зорро" (main.js's fbeUserName, which could override it, is not read: the editor has no main.js).

A poem with a title or an epigraph, or with a stanza that has a title, is left as it is: dissolving it would leave a title or an epigraph inside the text of a section, which FB2 does not allow (2.7.9 did so and asked before saving such a book).
A stanza's subtitle that ends up in an epigraph (a poem inside an epigraph) becomes a paragraph: FB2 allows no subtitle there.

By the requester's decision (2026-10-31) the history line carries no user name: youName is empty, the original's own way to a line without a name, so the line reads "v.<new version> —  Скрипт: «Поверхностное расформатирование всех стихов» 1.5 — (<date>)" and a line of the last ten days is extended when it ends "— (<date>)"; 2.7.9's default was the placeholder "Зорро" (main.js's fbeUserName, which could override it, is not read: the editor has no main.js).

The links of the book's annotation and history are not listed: the original took every <A> of FictionBook Editor's page, which holds the annotation and the history before the bodies; the conversion walks the bodies (since 0.0.1; 10/show-all-links, updated in this recheck, lists them).

Only text counts as a link's content: a link that holds nothing but an inline picture is not listed, and a picture inside a link splits it in two; the original listed every <A> with its innerText, to which a picture adds nothing (since 0.0.1).
Two links with the same target and type written right next to each other count as one: the editor reads them as one link (and writes them so).

The targets are shown as written in the book, the value the script's tests are written for ("#" at the start, "(null)" for an empty target). FictionBook Editor's engine could give the original getAttribute("href") resolved against its page (file:///…/main.html#id), and the original then flagged every internal link with [!!!]: the editor's own code reads targets with getAttribute(name, 2), the flag for the written value, and 2.7.9's 06/17 and 06/50 allow for both forms (since 0.0.1).

The list opens in the editor's report window (title " :: Links :: ", the text as written, in the window's type, with Copy and Save as...; modeless, it stays open after the run), not in an IE window of 300 × 710 pixels showing the page HTML/Показать все-все ссылки.html in its small grey centred type. The report window has the size of the editor's report windows and scrolls; it cannot be resized, where 2.7.9's window can (2.7.9 spells its feature resizable=yes, which 2.7beta1 misspelt resizeble).
Two links with the same target and type written right next to each other count as one: the editor reads them as one link (and writes them so).

The targets are shown as written in the book, the value the script's tests are written for ("#" at the start, "(null)" for an empty target). FictionBook Editor's engine could give the original getAttribute("href") resolved against its page (file:///…/main.html#id), and the original then flagged every internal link with [!!!]: the editor's own code reads targets with getAttribute(name, 2), the flag for the written value, and 2.7.9's 06/17 and 06/50 allow for both forms (since 0.0.1).

Paragraphs are the text blocks and empty lines of the bodies; the original counted every

of FictionBook Editor's page, which also holds the paragraphs of the book's annotation and history (one empty paragraph each when the book has none) (since 0.0.1).

The text size is the editor's count of the bodies' characters (doc.stats); the original took the length of the page's text (the innerText of the Body view: the annotation, the history and the bodies, with the line breaks between paragraphs) (since 0.0.1).

Illustrations are the block and inline pictures of the bodies (doc.stats); the original counted every of the page: also those of the annotation, and the two preview pictures of the description page (prevImg, fullImg), so it gave two more than the book has (since 0.0.1).
Footnotes are the note links of the bodies; the original counted every <A class=note> of the page, those of the annotation and the history included (since 0.0.1).

the original saved its text only as its setting SaveStat said (0, the default: never; 1: to the clipboard; 2: to a TXT file, each after its question); a bundled script cannot be edited, so both questions are asked after the results, one after the other: copy the text to the clipboard (mfbe.clipboard.writeText), then save it as a TXT file in UTF-16 LE through the editor's Save dialog (mfbe.files.saveText, proposing 'Общая статистика (<date> <time>).txt')
the result message shows no proverb: left out pending the requester's decision

inline formatting is counted in the editor's terms: an element is a run of text that carries one mark (bold italics: a run that is both italic and bold), so adjacent elements of one kind count once and the nesting of the file does not split them; 2.7.9 counted the elements of its page as the file nested them. A note link's formatting is taken as inside the link, which matters only for '[N]' and '{N}' written as note links ('…]', '…}')
openQuestions: restore the proverb of the result message?

entries.reason: Left out by the requester's decision (2026-10-31): the script has nothing to do with editing the book.

fixes: a main body with a stress mark (U+0301) but no Cyrillic letter passed the original's check for Russian letters (its class included the stress mark), and the original then failed on the missing word list (a script error); the conversion shows the original's message 'В разделе <body> нет слов.' there

entries.source: 13_Заголовки, подзаголовки, пустые строки/05_Разметить заголовки разделов либо подзаголовки, найденные по регэкспу....js

names.ru: Разметить заголовки разделов либо подзаголовки, найденные по регэкспу

htmlDialogs: HTML/Разметить заголовки разделов либо подзаголовки, найденные по регэкспу - задание параметров.htm
differences: Tier 3: the modeless dialog, which stayed open for further runs, is one form. Its two rows of buttons (Разметить заголовки / ... и выйти, Разметить подзаголовки / ... и выйти, Выйти) are the choice "Разметить" (titles or subtitles) with OK and Cancel; its 51 ready-made patterns are the presets of the pattern field, whose validity check replaces the original's message about a pattern that does not compile.

A part of a section left with its title only (and its epigraphs, picture or annotation), and a new section with nothing after its title, get an <empty-line/>, which FB2 requires; when nothing precedes the first new title, the first new section keeps the section's id. 2.7.9 wrote the invalid sections and dropped the emptied section, its id with it, when saving.
An empty line (or a paragraph of spaces) chosen as a subtitle stays an empty line, counted as in 2.7.9: 2.7.9 wrote an empty subtitle, which it saved as an <empty-line/>.

The package keeps its folder scripts/13_subtitles/05_split-into-sections and its id 08/split-into-sections (recheck rule 2), so the Scripts menu shows it as 02 of Структура разделов; 2.7.9 moved the script to Заголовки, подзаголовки, пустые строки as 05.
fixes: An empty pattern is refused for titles as well, with the message 2.7.9 shows for subtitles ("Вы не ввели никакой регэксп. Пожалуйста, введите регэксп для поиска заголовков ..."). 2.7.9's title buttons ran with it: the empty expression matched every paragraph and empty line of the text bodies, each of which became the title of a section of its own. The intent is clear from the subtitle buttons' check, whose message speaks of finding titles; the 2.7beta1 conversion refused an empty pattern already.

entries.source: 13_Заголовки, подзаголовки, пустые строки/06_Разметить заголовки разделов либо подзаголовки, найденные по регэкспу... (расширенная версия).js

names.ru: Разметить заголовки разделов либо подзаголовки, найденные по регэкспу... (расширенная версия)
names.en: Razmetit titles of sections libo subtitles, naydennye po regekspu... (rasshirennaya versiya)

htmlDialogs: HTML/Разметить заголовки разделов либо подзаголовки, найденные по регэкспу (расширенная версия) - задание параметров.htm
differences: The modeless dialog, which stayed open for further runs, is a modal form (one run per invocation): its button rows "Разметить заголовки" / "Разметить заголовки и выйти" and "Разметить подзаголовки" / "Разметить подзаголовки и выйти" are the choice "Разметить" (titles or subtitles) and OK; its ready-made patterns are the presets of a 'regexp' field, whose validity check (OK disabled) replaces the message about a pattern that does not compile; the maximum length is a number field.

A part of a section left with nothing but its title, epigraphs, image or annotation, and a new section with nothing after its title, get an <empty-line/>: FB2 and the editor require a block there; 2.7.9 wrote the invalid section.

When nothing precedes the first new title of a section, the first new section keeps the section's id and language; 2.7.9 left the emptied section, which it dropped (with its id) when the book was saved, so the new section had no id.
An empty line, or a paragraph of spaces, chosen as a subtitle stays as it is: 2.7.9 gave it the subtitle class, which it saved as an <empty-line/> again; it is counted as in 2.7.9.
The caret stays where it was; 2.7.9 put it at the start of the book after rewriting the sections.

The test "right after a title or subtitle" is made for each paragraph: under the legacy JScript engine the original's /^(sub)?title$/gi literal was one shared object whose lastIndex could make consecutive tests alternate (engine-dependent, not the script's intent); not reproduced.

The bold and italic tests run on the legacy inline-HTML notation, where formatting with a language (which 2.7.9 did not keep) is written <STRONG lang=...>/<EM lang=...> and does not count as plain bold or italics, as in the other converted scripts.

entries.source: 13_Заголовки, подзаголовки, пустые строки/07_Разметить заголовки разделов согласно оглавлению документа....js

names.ru: Разметить заголовки разделов согласно оглавлению документа
names.en: Razmetit titles of sections soglasno oglavleniyu dokumenta

htmlDialogs: HTML/Разметить заголовки разделов согласно оглавлению документа - основной диалог.htm
differences: The modal dialog, which stayed open after each action, is a form shown again after each action until it is closed (Закрыть); its two buttons ("Удалить из оглавления лишние символы", "Разметить заголовки разделов согласно списку") are the choice "Действие" and OK; the list is a multi-line text field.

A part of a section left with nothing but its title and a new section with nothing after its title get an <empty-line/> (FB2 and the editor require a block; 2.7.9 wrote the invalid section); the first new section keeps the section's id when nothing precedes it (2.7.9 dropped the emptied section with its id on saving).
fixes: The selected contents are skipped wherever the selection starts and ends (every text block from the first to the last selected one). 2.7.9 recognised the contents only when their first paragraph was a paragraph of a section itself: a selection starting in the contents' title turned the contents' own paragraphs (which equal their lines) into one joined title, and one ending in a cite, poem or title skipped every paragraph to the end of the book. With the fix those runs mark up the book's titles instead (snapshot titles-from-contents.toc-title: nothing to mark up, the contents untouched).

An empty list gives the message the original meant to show ("Список не содержит ни одного заголовка, поэтому заголовки в этот раз не были размечены.") and returns to the dialog; 2.7.9 stopped with a script error (Arr.length of null) before reaching it.
openQuestions: A line of the list can make several paragraphs titles: the original marks a matched line as used only for the list it leaves, it still compares used lines; kept as 2.7.9.

entries.source: 13_Заголовки, подзаголовки, пустые строки/30_Привести заголовки глав к виду 'Глава 1'.js
fixes: Where the replaced part reaches the end of the title, the space the replacement string ends with is not written: "Четырнадцатая глава" becomes "Глава 14" (2.7.9: "Глава 14 "), likewise "XIII. " -> "Глава 13.", "Глава четырнадцатая," -> "Глава 14,", "Первая глава " -> "Глава 1". The replacements "Глава N. " and "Глава N " were written for a title that goes on after the number; when nothing follows, the trailing space is a clear defect of the target form "Глава 1".
openQuestions: Three expressions are not anchored at the start: with text before "Глава" the 0-based search position is used as the 1-based start of the replacement, so "Пролог. Глава XII. Ночь" becomes "ПрологГлава 12. Ночь" (the ". " before "Глава" is eaten). Whether such titles should be normalised at all (the other expressions are anchored) is unclear; kept as 2.7.9.
A non-breaking space between the words of a numeral stops the table lookup (only runs of two or more spaces are collapsed): "Глава сорок<NBSP>первая" stays as it is; kept.
"Пятнадцатая глава, Встреча" loses the comma ("Глава 15 Встреча"): the branch "<числительное> глава" keeps only a dot or a colon; kept.
A word made of Roman letters is read as a numeral: a title "Liv" becomes "Глава 54"; kept.
The "Глава 30" branches count a title as replaced when its text differs from the new HTML, so a formatted title is counted though unchanged (message only); kept.

names.ru: Удалить форматирование в заголовках и подзаголовках
names.en: Udalit formatting into zagolovkakh and podzagolovkakh

differences: The random proverb the original appended to its results window is left out, pending the requester's decision: the list (277 sayings, the 271 of the book «Пословицы и поговорки Великой Отечественной войны» plus six about Kursk and Sudzha) includes calls to kill "fascists".

In the "show" mode (setting 2) the line is selected in the Body view instead of being underlined in red and scrolled with the window's measures; the Да / Нет / Отмена browsing is a message with three buttons. The original's check that the Body ("B") view is shown has no counterpart.

The history entry (setting Version_on_off, off by default) carries no user name, by the requester's decision (2026-10-31): youName is empty, the original's own way to a line without a name, so the entry reads "v.<new version> —  Скрипт: «Удаление форматирования в заголовках и подзаголовках» 2.4 — <date>" and a recent line is extended when it ends "— <date>"; 2.7.9's default was the placeholder "Зорро", and the original's override by a global fbeUserName of main.js does not exist.
The expressions run on the legacy inline-HTML notation, where formatting with a language (which 2.7.9 did not keep) is written with lang=... and is left alone, as in the other converted scripts.
fixes: The code and style checks of the titles in the notes and comments bodies test the title itself; the original tested a variable left over from the previous line, so a notes title entirely in code ("2") kept the code unless the line before happened to hold code. openQuestions: The bold, italic, index and strikethrough tests run on the line's HTML, where   counts as the letters n, b, s, p: "Глава 3" keeps its bold; kept as 2.7.9.
Letters are А-я, Ёё, A-Za-z and Α-ω only: Ukrainian і, ї, є, ґ count as no letters; kept.

differences: The dialog's Browse button is gone: the script sandbox has no file picker, so the file name is typed (since 0.0.1); the dialog is a modal form with a label and a line of help.
The undo step is named after the script (its undoLabel); 2.7.9 named it «создание ссылки на MIDI-файл (для AlReader'а)».
fixes: A name typed after the box's "file:", or typed with that prefix, gives the link file:NAME, and a name left empty changes nothing; the original wrote file:file:NAME and file:file: (kept from the 0.0.1 conversion, whose box started empty).

htmlDialogs: HTML/Обзор и превращение элементов - набор фреймов.html
differences: The three-frame dialog is a loop of two forms (the kind, then the list with the action); the list is a form field: plain text without the original's formatting and link tooltips, no 'selected' counter, no Ctrl+A, and choosing an element does not show it in the book.
Undo and Redo of the dialog are Edit > Undo after the run (the whole run is one undo step); the original's 'Выполнено.' after a case change and its counts are a status-bar line.

Subtitles as titles: where FB2 allows the content in front of the subtitle nowhere at the end of the previous container of the same kind (after its subsections, or content that starts with an epigraph or annotation), it goes to a new container, as in 2.7beta1; 2.7.9 appended it there and wrote invalid FB2.
Subtitles as titles: a subtitle in a section's annotation stays a subtitle (2.7.9 put a title into the annotation and moved the section's whole content).
An edit the FB2 schema still refuses is reported in a message and that body is left as it was, instead of producing an invalid book.
fixes: Leading lines of a title (not the whole title) moved to the end of a previous section that ends with empty lines not preceded by a subtitle were dropped: the else-if after `if (isSubtitle(pInPreviousSection))` repeated the same condition, so the lines, already taken out of the title, were inserted nowhere and the script stopped with an error (markerEnd null). They now go to the end of that section, with an empty line after them in the 'framed by empty lines' mode - that branch's own body (snapshot 19/element-browser.titles-to-framed-subtitles.leading.xml).

With subtitles framed by empty lines, when the selection goes on in a later title, the last unselected lines of a title were followed by two empty lines framing an insertion of nothing; nothing is inserted now (19/element-browser.titles-to-framed-subtitles.lines.xml).

Merging a section that holds nothing but subtitles after a section ending with a subtitle and an empty line (titles as subtitles or framed subtitles) stopped with a script error: moving1 read tt.nextSibling with nothing left; the merge now completes (19/element-browser.titles-to-subtitles.merge.xml).
The number asked by 'N-ное «слово» каждого элемента – большими буквами…' is read as a decimal number; JScript's eval read a leading zero as octal ('010' gave the 8th word).
openQuestions: 'Первая буква большая, остальные маленькие' now upper-cases the first character (the second after « or "), not the first letter as 2.7beta1 did: '— и снова Глава' gives '— и снова глава'. Kept as 2.7.9.

'Первую букву каждого слова (кроме исключений)…' matches the abbreviation list ignoring case and upper-cases what it finds, so the list's mixed-case entries come out in capitals (КоАП -> КОАП, СНиП -> СНИП, СПбГУ -> СПБГУ). Kept as 2.7.9.

moveBlockIntoPreviousBlock adds an empty line in front of a subtitle that becomes the first child of an empty container in every mode: its condition `&& "subtitles with empty lines before and after"` is a string, always true. Kept as written; it is reached only in rare structures (a converted title starting with an empty line).

Where 2.7.9's result was invalid FB2 (which it then refused to save) the text goes to the first place the schema accepts: the text of a section's title or epigraph followed by the section's picture and annotation goes after them (2.7.9 put it in front, leaving the annotation after paragraphs), and in a section of sections into a section of its own before the subsections; a stanza's title before the stanza's subtitle becomes verses after the subtitle.

Attributes a paragraph cannot have (a cell's colspan or alignment in a cite's table) are dropped; a blank table cell (spaces, non-breaking spaces or nothing) becomes an empty line, as 2.7.9 saved such a paragraph; a cell's language (xml:lang, which 2.7.9 never read) stays.

Afterwards the caret is at the start of the first paragraph that came out of the element (2.7.9 left the browser's selection); a status-bar line says when the caret is in none of the elements (2.7.9 did nothing without a word).

differences: The hit is selected exactly where the expression matched, and the search starts exactly at the end of the selection: the original moved IE's selection by its own character count, which was off after inline pictures (three placeholder characters in the text the expressions saw) and soft hyphens.
The view scrolls the hit into sight instead of the original's own scrolling step.

An inline picture selected as text is searched past like text: the original refused a picture clicked into a 'Control' selection ("Не обрабатываемый тип выделения: sel.type") but selected a hit on a picture as text, and the editor cannot tell the two apart; a selected block picture is still refused.
Line breaks of any platform count as line breaks (the original knew Windows' CR LF only, so text copied with LF line breaks was read as one line).
After OK to "Перейти в начало документа?" the caret goes to the first text block of the first body (FictionBook Editor's body view began with the book's annotation and history).
The clipboard is read through the editor (mfbe.clipboard.readText), which allows it only in a run the user started: in a run the AI assistant started the script says so and stops.
fixes: Answering Cancel to "Перейти в начало документа?" made the original search again from the start of the paragraph it began in (searchNext returned true and its loop ran it once more) and, finding nothing there, ask again: the question came back until OK was pressed. Cancel now ends the run ("NotFound"); the result differs from 2.7.9 only in that the question is asked once.

entries.reason: Left out by the requester's decision (2026-10-31): the script has nothing to do with editing the book.

differences: A bundled script cannot be edited in place: the template's comment and its window say how to fill in a copy (Scripts > Open scripts folder, a new id in the copy's script.json, Scripts > Reload scripts). The sections НАСТРОЙКИ and ДОБАВЛЯЕМЫЕ ДАННЫЕ keep the original's names, values and form (with English guidance added), so a section filled in for FictionBook Editor can be pasted unchanged.

The data are written into the document's description (mfbe.doc.get, one mfbe.doc.setDescription) instead of the fields of the Description form and the annotation and history blocks of the IE page: the model's empty list stands for the form's blank row, an absent annotation or history for the Body view's empty block, an empty line the script adds is an empty-line (as 2.7.9 saved it), and an annotation or history left with empty lines only is not written (2.7.9 did not save it).

By the requester's decision (2026-10-31) the history line carries no user name: the setting youName is empty (2.7.9's default was the placeholder "Зорро"), the original's own way to a line without a name, so the line (setting Version_on_off, off as shipped) reads "v.<new version> —  <TextHistory> — <date>" and a line of the last ten days is extended when it ends "— <date>"; a global fbeUserName in main.js is not read (there is no main.js).
A language code is written as given: FictionBook Editor's language list box took only the codes of its list.
A sequence number that is not an integer is left out: the editor's model, like FB2 (xs:integer), holds integers only; 2.7.9 wrote the text as typed.
The language of a sequence and of a custom-info entry, which FictionBook Editor's form did not hold, stays with the entry the template fills.

The window of results is the editor's message box, in Russian or English; its hint for the template as shipped adds how to fill in a copy. The undo label is the package's, with the original's label as the step's name (mfbe.edit.label).

Another script may run the template with settings and data of its own (the same names) and today (YYYY-MM-DD, the date the script takes as today) in the args of mfbe.scripts.run; the suite's reference runs fill it this way.
The reminder about the caret in a text field of the Description form (setting Napominanie) is not shown: it guarded against a crash of FictionBook Editor that this editor does not have.
fixes: A person the template adds beyond the book's persons starts without an id: 2.7.9 added the form row as a copy of the row before, and version 1.4 keeps a row's id when the data give none, so the new author got the previous author's id.

The texts the template looks for are matched as written: the new history line and the new annotation lines (already there?), the history text and the name, the dates and the version (HistoryChange). 2.7.9 used them as regular expressions, so a text with brackets, '+', '?' or '[' was added again on every run, or stopped the script with a syntax error.
openQuestions: An author the template fills keeps the id of the book's author in that row when the data give no id (version 1.4: 'if (ID && mID[k] && …)'; version 1.2 cleared it). Kept as 1.4 behaves: is the id meant to stay with the row?

The five templates 01 to 05 are copies of version 1.2 of the template, the source template 00 is version 1.4 (the author fixed the copy's checks in 1.3 and 1.4 but did not refresh the copies); each package keeps its own version's behaviour. Should the five copies follow version 1.4?

differences: The description is the document's (mfbe.doc.get, one mfbe.doc.setDescription) and the intermediate body is a body of the book (mfbe.doc.insertNode, mfbe.doc.removeNode); the model's empty list stands for the form's blank row.

The body is placed after the book's first body, not before it: a script cannot remove the first body, so a body placed first could not be taken out again. A description body that a book saved by FictionBook Editor between the steps holds first is replaced by the book's next body when it is taken out.

FB2 needs content after a section's title and after its annotation: an empty line follows the title of 'Название', of each sequence and of the explanation; the second step passes over it. An empty data line is an empty paragraph (to type into), a blank line of the explanation an empty-line, as 2.7.9 saved them.
The caret goes to the start of the new body's title, which brings it into view (2.7.9 only scrolled there); a name in error is selected instead of coloured.

The reminder about the caret in a field of the Description form (setting Napominanie) and the setting for the window's height (Vysota_teksta) are gone, and so are the window's pages: the editor has no such crash and its message box scrolls.

By the requester's decision (2026-10-31) the history line carries no user name: the setting youName is empty (2.7.9's default was the placeholder "Зорро"), the original's own way to a line without a name, so the line reads "v.<new version> —  Скрипт: «Редакция описания документа» 1.1 — <date>" and a line of the last ten days is extended when it ends "— <date>"; a global fbeUserName in main.js is not read (there is no main.js).
The window of results is one message box in Russian or English; the results show no proverb: left out pending the requester's decision.

Fields that the body's text does not hold come back for the names left unchanged: a translator's or document author's id and the second and further e-mails and home pages (2.7.9's Description form held none of them, so FictionBook Editor lost them), and a sequence's language.
A sequence number that is not an integer is left out: the editor's model, like FB2, holds integers only; 2.7.9 wrote the text as typed.

Another script may run it with settings of its own (the names of its section НАСТРОЙКИ) and today (YYYY-MM-DD) in the args of mfbe.scripts.run; the suite's reference runs use this for both steps in one run and for a fixed history date.
fixes: A person without a name or nickname before the end of a list no longer stops the script: 2.7.9 dropped the last row instead of that one (M.pop()), which left a hole in the list on which the sorting failed; such a person is left out, as the code means (step 1 and the lists not shown).

The texts looked for in the history (the name, the script's name, the dates, the version) are matched as written, not as regular expressions: a name with brackets or other special characters no longer stops the script.
A date value with the month 00 no longer makes the text date with the month 'undefined' (AddDate, ChangeDate); such a value is left alone.
A language copied from the source language of <title-info> into <src-title-info> is reported as 'Язык' (2.7.9 reported 'Язык оригинала').
openQuestions: Answering Yes to 'Прервать выполнение скрипта?' (a name with one separator too many) keeps what the second step wrote before that name, raises the version with a history line, and keeps the body: kept as 2.7.9 behaves. Should Yes rather leave the description as it was?
Restore the proverb of the result message?

entries.reason: A mode of the editor's view, not an edit: it makes the Body view's page read-only (contentEditable false) and installs its own click, key and mouse-wheel handlers on it, which stay after the script ends - the arrow keys and the wheel scroll by whole text lines (measured with getBoundingClientRect and getClientRects, scrolled with scrollBy), a click on a link to the book jumps to its target and Backspace back, any other click leaves the mode with the caret at the clicked point (moveToPoint). A script can neither change the view's editability nor receive its events, and its run ends before the reading begins (FR-024: the editor's own page). The 2.7.9 file is the 2.7beta1 one unchanged.
entries.needs: A reading mode of the Body view in the editor itself: a read-only view with line-wise scrolling and a back stack of followed links. No script API within principle V could offer it.

differences: Only emphasis and strong may surround the number (since 0.0.1): the original's expression allowed the tags EM, I, B and STRONG around it, which are those two marks in the editor's model.
The undo step is named after the script (its undoLabel); 2.7.9 named it «сделывание нумерации в началах абзацев – надстрочным текстом».
fixes: A number inside two nested formatting elements keeps both, and the rest of the paragraph keeps its formatting; the original's replacement "$1<SUP>$3</SUP>$4$6" kept only the last opening tag before the number and the last closing tag after it (its groups hold their last repetition), which broke the paragraph's formatting (kept from the 0.0.1 conversion).
A selected picture gets the script's message «Нет выделения. ...»; the original stopped with a script error there (its selection was then a control range, which has no compareEndPoints).
openQuestions: The original re-selected with tr1.setEndPoint("StartToStart", tr2) from the start marker's range to the end marker's; that is taken here, as for the group's other scripts, as selecting the processed text. differences: The dialog is a form without its live preview.

Its number fields always hold a number, so the original's warnings "Начальное число должно быть целым!" and "Шаг инкремента должен быть целым!" cannot occur; a fraction counts by its integer part, as parseInt took it.
The prefix and the suffix are put in as text; the original inserted them as HTML (insertAdjacentHTML), so tags or entities typed into them were interpreted.
A selected picture counts as no selection (the message, then every paragraph); 2.7.9 stopped with a script error (its selection was then a control range).
fixes: A start number of 0 starts at 0: the original's parseInt(settings.startNumber) || 1 made 0 into 1, although the dialog accepts it and the description says the count may start at any number, a negative one too.
openQuestions: A step of 0 is taken as 1, as the original's parseInt(settings.increment) || 1 did; was a step of 0 (the same number on every paragraph) meant to be possible?

differences: The lines found are selected exactly, from the start of the first to the end of the last; the original moved the end of IE's selection by a count it worked out from the section's HTML (colSumb: the characters of the lines and one per line break, the line break before the first line included, no inline picture).
The editor scrolls the selection into view; the original's scrollIfItNeeds is not reproduced.

A selected block picture is refused with the message of group 16's conversions ("Ошибка. Вы используете тип выделения, который не поддерживатся этим скриптом..."); the original stopped with a script error.
The message for a selection in an input field is gone: a script sees the Body view only.
fixes: The temporary marks of a superscript at the end of a line (a footnote number) were looked for as "<sup>" and "</sup>" without the i flag, which the page's upper-case <SUP> never matched, so a line ending with a full stop and a superscript number was taken for an epigraph's last line; the marks are set now and the number moves before the punctuation, as [1], {1} and * did. On the reference book 2.7.9 selects «Всё проходит.[1]» and «И это пройдёт.²» of chapter 6 as an epigraph; the conversion passes them.

The expression that cuts the lines after an epigraph's last line read [\\}\]»”“*] (a backslash) where the definition of that line - rxEndStr, and the commented-out endStr the expression was written from - reads [\)\}\]»”“*] (a closing bracket): a last line ending with ")" ("(Из старой песни)") now ends the epigraph. 2.7.9 took the short lines after it too: four lines of chapter 7 of the reference book, the conversion two.
openQuestions: rxCopyright /^©|®/ is tested on the whole section's HTML without the m flag: a © at the start of a line never matches (the HTML starts with "<DIV"), and a ® anywhere in the section passes the whole section over, whereas the changelog of 1.12 speaks of lines starting with © and of ®. Kept as 2.7.9 behaves.

A section with an id (rxP /^<DIV class=section>/ does not match <DIV id=... class=section>) that holds an epigraph, an annotation, a citation or a poem anywhere is passed over ("Это просто DIV!"), the same section without an id is looked at. Kept as 2.7.9 behaves (chapters 13 and 14 of the reference book).

The search stops at the first section, or section holding one, whose id looks like a note's (n_1, c2, comment_3, FbAutId_4, bookmark_5): an ordinary chapter with such an id - FictionBook Editor gave FbAutId_ ids to link targets - stops it before the notes. Kept as 2.7.9 behaves.

differences: A stanza left without a verse, a table row left without a cell and a table left without a row go, and a result that would still not be valid FB2 (a poem left without stanzas) changes nothing and says so; 2.7.9 left such elements and then refused to save the book until it was mended by hand.
A formatting element is a run of text with one mark: two adjacent elements with the same formatting, which the original saw as two (neither spanning the last paragraph's text), are one.
The editor scrolls the caret into view; the original's GoToEndOfElement scrolled by its own rule.
fixes: A selection starting or ending inside formatting (italics, bold, a link...) took the paragraph only from or up to that formatting element - the original widened the selection to the element holding each end (parentElement), which there is the formatting element - and then removed only that element from the paragraph, or stopped with a script error when the selection began inside formatting and ended later in the same paragraph; the whole paragraphs are taken now, as the script's name says.

A selected picture gets the message the original wrote for it ("Вы используете не тот тип выделения, с которым работает вставка эпиграфа..."), which its code never reached: its range of a picture (a control range) has no duplicate(), so it stopped with a script error.
openQuestions: The text-author test of the last paragraph meant to compare the element spanning it with the single element of the paragraph before it (upTag), but for (pptag in pptags) runs over the array's indices ("0", "1"...), never equal to a tag name: the last of two or more paragraphs becomes the text author whenever one element spans its whole text. Kept as 2.7.9 behaves - the same code is FictionBook Editor's own Add epigraph (main.js, AddEpigraph); what the comparison should decide (two lines both in italics, an element that spans only part of the line before) is not clear.

differences: The tables are shown in the editor's report window (mfbe.ui.report), with the style of HTML/Показать таблицы в HTML-виде.html and the title ' :: Таблицы в виде HTML :: '; its Copy and Save as… give the HTML.

The setting display = 1 (a temporary HTML file opened in the default browser through WScript.Shell) is gone: it needs a file of the script's own and another program (FR-024); Save as… of the report window gives such a file.

The HTML is written from the table of the document model (lib/table-html.js), not by rewriting the page's HTML; as in 2.7.9 the ids and styles are left out, the 'fb' prefix of the attributes is gone (colspan, rowspan, align, valign) and non-breaking spaces become spaces.
The characters □▫◦ stay as they are: 2.7.9 replaced them by spaces because they stood for non-breaking spaces in FictionBook Editor's view, while this editor keeps non-breaking spaces as such.
A picture in a cell shows its name (an img with the href as its alt text): a script gets no picture's bytes and a report shows only pictures embedded in it (2.7.9's IE window loaded the picture).
The table is selected with mfbe.selection.selectNode; without a table to the end of the book the caret goes to the end of the selection (mfbe.selection.set), as tr.collapse(false) did.
The search runs through the bodies; the tables of the book's annotation and history are not looked at (in 2.7.9 only a caret in the annotation reached them).
fixes: An empty cell no longer takes the next cell's text: 2.7.9's expression for a cell wanted at least one character, so an empty cell and the cell after it became one cell and the row lost a cell.
A cell or table whose id is not a word (a hyphen in it) is converted like the others: 2.7.9's expressions removed only ids of letters and digits and then did not convert that P or DIV.

differences: The tables are shown in the editor's report window (mfbe.ui.report), with the style of HTML/Показать таблицы в HTML-виде.html and the title ' :: Таблицы в виде HTML :: '; its Copy and Save as… give the HTML.

The characters □▫◦ stay as they are: 2.7.9 replaced them by spaces because they stood for non-breaking spaces in FictionBook Editor's view, while this editor keeps non-breaking spaces as such.
A picture in a cell shows its name (an img with the href as its alt text): a script gets no picture's bytes and a report shows only pictures embedded in it (2.7.9's IE window loaded the picture).
The tables are taken in the order of the page: the book's annotation, the history, then every body.
fixes: A table or cell whose id is not a word (a hyphen in it) is shown and counted like the others: 2.7.9 kept only the lines that start with a bare table tag, so such a table lost its <table> (its rows were shown alone) and was not counted in 'Табл. N из M'.

names.ru: Помочь заменить таблицы на их изображения
names.en: Pomoch zamenit tablitsy on their izobrazheniya

differences: The work is done on the document model: the first pass inserts the label and the picture before each table with mfbe.doc.insertNode; the second pass writes each changed body back with mfbe.doc.replaceNode (a body left empty is removed with mfbe.doc.removeNode) and the annotation and the history with mfbe.doc.setDescription.

Where FB2 allows no picture (in a citation, an annotation or the history) only the label is inserted, and right after a section's annotation the picture comes after the label; the status line names the tables left without a picture. 2.7.9 inserted the picture there too, which FB2 does not allow.

Where the second pass leaves a section with no content after its title, epigraphs, picture and annotation (or with no content at all), or with a picture first there, an empty line stays: FB2 needs content there and no picture first, while 2.7.9 left the section so. An emptied first body keeps one section with an empty line (a book needs its first body).
The questions are the editor's message boxes with OK and Cancel, in Russian or English; the counts go to the status line, which stays after the run.
fixes: The tables are counted whatever their attributes: 2.7.9 counted only tables written exactly <DIV class=table> (no style, no id), so with a styled table the labels were numbered wrongly (three tables, one with a style: 'zzz_табл 0 из 2_zzz' for the first).
openQuestions: The second pass does not delete the labels in annotations (the book's and the sections'), in the history and in the notes and comments bodies: the original's walker skips them (its flags processAnnotation and processHistory are false), although the first pass puts labels there. Kept as 2.7.9 behaves.
The second pass deletes the labels also when the book has no table left, and then says that there are no tables: kept as 2.7.9 behaves.

differences: Shows the JSON of the document model where 2.7.9 showed the HTML of the editor's page: scripts see the book as the document model, not the editor's page (kept from the conversion of 2.7beta1).

A defect of the conversion; the result is now 2.7.9's.

fixes: With the caret in the book's annotation or history the script shows the annotation's or the history's code, as 2.7.9 showed its HTML; the conversion of 2.7beta1 stopped there with an error (it asked doc.getNode, which knows the bodies only).
